# Medwin Publishers

> Medwin Publishers is an open-access academic publisher operating 90+ peer-reviewed journals across medical and scientific disciplines with commitment to research ethics, author rights, and scholarly integrity.

Medwin Publishers specializes in open-access medical and scientific publishing, offering comprehensive journal portfolios and transparent publishing standards. The platform emphasizes double-blind peer review, Creative Commons licensing, and equitable access to research globally.

## Publishing Policies & Standards

- [Open Access Policy](https://medwinpublishers.com/open-access-policy): Open access publishing policy and commitment details
- [Peer Review Policy](https://medwinpublishers.com/peer-review-policy): Double-blind peer review policy and manuscript evaluation standards
- [Copyright & Licensing Policy](https://medwinpublishers.com/copyright-policy): Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licensing and author rights
- [Licensing Policy](https://medwinpublishers.com/licensing-policy): CC-BY licensing policy for author rights and manuscript reuse
- [Publication Ethics & Malpractice Statement](https://medwinpublishers.com/publication-ethics-and-publication-malpractice-statement): Comprehensive publication ethics and transparency standards
- [Conflict of Interest Policy](https://medwinpublishers.com/conflict-of-Interest-policy): Conflict of interest disclosure and management requirements
